$comment: Single source of truth for the PaperBell v4 -> v5 (CIMPO) migration. Read by scripts/plan.mjs. JSON (not YAML) on purpose: plan.mjs is zero-dependency and a hand-rolled YAML parser for a config this nested would be the fragile part. Every rule carries a `provenance` string instead of a comment. 'diff' below means `git -C PaperBell diff be616ce^ be616ce -M -- PaperBell/` in PaperBell-Org/PaperBell (be616ce = 'feat(project)!: adopt CIMPO numbered vault').

detect.provenance: v4 tree = be616ce^ (also branch v4); v5 tree = be616ce. Paths are vault-relative.

frontmatterRules.provenance: 00 - Obsidian/模板/zt-field.eta.md (v5) writes `keywords:` instead of `concepts:` and drops tags containing ⭐/🌟 ('星标进 important，不污染关键词'); `important` stays a boolean = has tag 🌟星标. Docs CIMPO: inputs '只带 keywords，不带 concepts'. Rule: keywords = existing keywords ∪ (concepts minus star items, [[wikilinks]] unwrapped); unset concepts; a 🌟 item sets important: true; a ⭐-only item sets important: true only if important is missing (an explicit false is kept).
00 - Obsidian/模板/术语模板-手动.md (v5) adds `category: concept` + `featured: false` ('与 Cards Wrangler 生成的卡片保持同一套 schema').
00 - Obsidian/模板/机构模板.md: tags university -> institute; obsidian-map-view/data.json query tag:#university -> tag:#institute.

needsAgentRules.provenance: PaperBell-Project-Manager/src/core/stage.ts (PHASE_TO_STAGE, STATUS_TO_STAGE) and schemaMigration.ts (TYPE_RENAMES 软件->开发). Numeric status 0-3 from v4 Projects/00. 项目列表.base formula 进度. v5 项目模板.md: type ∈ 研究/开发/管理, workload = hours/week (1-40), acronym required; v4 项目模板.md: type ∈ 论文/基金/报告/书籍/其他, workload 1-5, `project` held the ID.

json.provenance: Every string value in .obsidian/*.json and .obsidian/plugins/<id>/data.json that equals a v4 folder or starts with '<v4 folder>/' is rewritten with the same table as the notes (longest prefix wins). Diff confirms this for app.json, daily-notes.json, templater, calendar, zotlit, quickadd, pexels-banner, obsidian-memos, paperbell, task-progress-bar.
json.skipFilesNote: PaperBell's own data.json is excluded: the plugin overwrites it from memory on its next save, and the legacy keys found there (noteLocation, institutionNoteTemplate, listenToFileCreatedInPath) are stripped on load anyway. CIMPO folders go through setCimpoFolders.

stringReplace.provenance: diff obsidian-map-view/data.json markerIconRules query tag:#university -> tag:#institute (pairs with the institute-tag frontmatter rule).
